per_claim_reviews.title: The selected scope and its unchanged exponent
checks: The same CCH15 extended full-block point, g=0 Kap, detector list and CAP13 T/TWPl are preserved. The exponent is exactly D0=4d+4q, with the one B1 constant before every truncation and eventual level.

The general local argument uses the original OoPt, which includes O→K surjectivity, and a=n>0. Both rank-four Links, original CohP/LocCFT/N4 and the outer common coefficient threshold remain explicit.

per_claim_reviews.title: Actual coefficient DVR and residue-compatible completion
checks: The coefficient lift and s↦t prove f is local and onto, and m_B=p+(s), on the original B. The coefficient-power-series evaluation uses completeness of B and the genuine original coefficient surjection.
O[[S]]_(varpi) has residue K((t)); its completed DVR OO and the map OO→R give the literal rF and ordinaryPointSection compatibilities. No flatness of OO→R is inferred.

per_claim_reviews.title: Full-law Cayley–Hamilton realization
checks: The source GDet is a natural homogeneous multiplicative polynomial law. The universal multivariable CH coefficient ideal matches that law, rather than only its characteristic traces.

The actual completed local ring is henselian; NP.span and surjectivity of h.p0 give a split absolutely irreducible residual representation. Chenevier Theorem 2.22(i) applies without inverting n or n!, including n=4 and ell=3. The residual conjugation fixes the specified original rho.

per_claim_reviews.title: Exact polarization in the original residual basis
checks: The source star operation descends using its trace identity and the perfect full-matrix trace pairing. The matrix-unit argument supplies the implementing form, and its residual identity is retained.

The involution relation and invertibility of 2 give a symmetric form H≡1. The written convergent matrix Newton procedure yields the square-root normalization; conjugation preserves the original residual representation and produces the exact form-1 equation.

per_claim_reviews.title: One finite B-algebra with original topology
checks: The trace Gram matrix is invertible after localization at the actual point prime. All group matrices lie in one finite trace-dual B-module P0, and their B-span M is finite and multiplicatively closed.

Uniform continuity of finitely many trace functions, followed by Artin–Rees for M⊂P0 at m_B, supplies the exact URep.cont estimate in m_B^j M. Krull intersection applies to this one finite original-B module.

per_claim_reviews.title: Every URep field and the original closed ideal
checks: Each algebraic source relation, including all CH coefficients and the ordinary/inertia/auxiliary relations, vanishes in the matrix realization. Continuity for every open normal neighborhood and every coefficient power kills the literal closureIdeal.

AA=R and N=0 give all direct-sum, typeI and span fields. Arbitrary scalar-field specialization of the universal CH quotient is Mat_n of that field, so the literal every-field NonSS condition is false. The thick condition is therefore vacuous; no false containment Ann(0)⊂Q is used.

per_claim_reviews.title: Relative cotangent space at the actual coefficient DVR
checks: The actual OO→R residue map is surjective. Subtracting coefficient lifts identifies OO-derivations to F with the dual of m_R/(m_OO R+m_R^2).
Well-definedness uses the coefficient ideal explicitly, and finite dimensionality follows from Noetherianity of the actual completed local ring. No unnecessary coefficient field section is assumed.

per_claim_reviews.title: Bounded matrix derivatives and the continuous cocycle
checks: Finite generators of p and the original O[[S]] coefficient lift put derivative values of B in one fractional A-lattice. The estimate on m_B^j is t^(j−1) times that same lattice.

Together with the single finite B-module M, this proves the derivative of the actual group matrices is uniformly bounded and continuous in the required t-adic topology. Multiplication by the original integral inverse rho_F preserves boundedness.

per_claim_reviews.title: Ordered ordinary flags over dual numbers
checks: Distinct residual characters admit one separating finite group-algebra combination over F. The Lagrange projectors are orthogonal and sum to one by the exact CH identity.

The ordered mixed ordinary product identifies diagonal characters and kills lower blocks. The matrix W=Σf_1,i f_0,i aligns the projectors and is congruent to 1. Its first-order conjugation has the stated z−dY sign and produces the literal original ordinary flag.

per_claim_reviews.title: The derivative lands in the original polarized Selmer space
checks: Differentiating the exact multiplier gives the source transpose/conjugation condition. The original inertia relations give zero on the prescribed inertia subgroup.

The ordinary correction is made in the specified w_v basis with the source ordered characters, and the coefficient-constant restrictions kill its required diagonal on mu_v. The selected g=0 Kap gives exactly Sel1, without a vanishing assertion.

per_claim_reviews.title: Injectivity into bounded Laurent Selmer classes
checks: A coboundary derivative is removed by the specified dual-number conjugation. The full determinant law then kills every original lambda_i generator; trace alone is not substituted in residue characteristic 3.

The ordered ordinary relations, q1/q2 and their distinct-root/ta normalizations kill the remaining character/root generators. GenBy and the uniform derivative bounds pass from the dense original algebra to B, then localization and the quotient modulo m_R^2 pass to R. This proves injectivity.

per_claim_reviews.title: Finite cocycle stabilization on one supplied Lim
checks: The exact original Lim supplies a fixed topologically finitely generated profinite group. Its index-two subgroup is finitely generated; there are only finitely many cocycles for each fixed finite action.

A finite intersection of normal cores treats all such cocycles at one truncation. ker_lim, p_lim and the uniform local phi comparisons transfer both Sel1 and its coboundaries. No infinite intersection or new limit is introduced, and eventual levels may depend on m.

per_claim_reviews.title: All truncation cardinality bounds on the limit
checks: For each fixed m, the finite-cocycle transfer and the original eventual B1 inequality meet in the same ultrafilter. The B1 constant was chosen before m and remains unchanged.
The zero truncation is handled directly, and the result bounds the literal quotient of Sel1 by the corresponding Bd1 rather than a different cohomology space.

per_claim_reviews.title: Uniform integral independence estimate
checks: The finite linear system in the coefficients and a skew matrix has a finitely generated row module over the complete DVR. Passing to finitely many equations is justified by Noetherianity.

Smith normal form gives a uniform loss in the valuation of a coefficient vector whose combination becomes a coboundary modulo t^m. The skew condition is lifted using 2 invertible. The estimate does not assume approximate solutions lift to exact ones.

per_claim_reviews.title: Exact K1, Laurent extension, and selected K2/K3
checks: The modular cardinality bound and the integral independence estimate force the number of independent classes to be at most D0. The Laurent statement uses one denominator for a finite list of bounded cocycles and their finitely many local correction matrices.
The claim is fixed-h and uses the same supplied Lim. K2 at g=0 has the explicit nonzero constant coefficient, and the full-block odd space makes K3 zero. It does not prove arbitrary-Kap CohLim.

per_claim_reviews.title: Cotangent rank bound with the exact dimension
checks: CRW11 and the fixed-h Laurent K1 give the bound dim_F Tp≤D0. The duality from CRW7 therefore supplies at most D0 relative cotangent generators.
The argument preserves the same actual coefficient/completion maps and introduces no support-prime existence assumption.

per_claim_reviews.title: Literal Ctx.Pres and power-series surjection
checks: Lifts of the cotangent generators, padded to exactly D0 variables, satisfy the original maximal-ideal generation statement; Nakayama gives the required full generation.
The g=0 odd/quadratic fields are checked at their empty scope. Successive homogeneous approximations produce the continuous surjection OO[[X_1,…,X_D0]]→R without assuming an embedded residue field.

per_claim_reviews.title: Original GalOut from the exact local dimension comparison
checks: The power-series ring is a Noetherian local domain with dimension 1+D0: the upper bound is the checked generator theorem and the lower bound is the explicit prime chain.

If an actual prime Z in R has dim(R/Z)≥1+D0, a nonzero inverse image would make an excessively long chain; hence it is zero, the presentation kernel is zero and Z=0. This is the required GalOut implication and does not assert that such a support prime exists.

per_claim_reviews.title: One-completion support implication
checks: The support ideal, dimension lower bound and literal fiber equivalence are retained on one actual completed patched quotient. Faithful flatness lifts the starting and target primes with their exact contractions.

A minimal prime below the lifted starting prime has the required dimension, so CRW18 forces it and the support ideal to be zero. The same fiber equivalence gives the target annihilator containment. The h=0 proof uses neither a move field nor a second completion.

per_claim_reviews.title: Conditional Core installation on the same patched construction
checks: The source Lim, RRObj, RMaps, TWAut, lifted OoPt and splitting algebra remain compatible original inputs. The quotient map pi and its composite pi_R=m.pi are distinguished explicitly.

The support dimension (1+D)+nq is exactly 1+D0. The retained annihilator/J equivalence, parameter identity and prime lifts descend the one-completion conclusion to the original same J. No patched ring, support or all-level automorphic module is fabricated.

per_claim_reviews.title: Completed subproducers and the exact remaining Raw cut
checks: The packet closes the normalized full-block URep, cotangent/presentation/GalOut and the conditional supplied-Lim and one-point support implications. It retains actual pro-ell descent, CoreBC normalization/Unit parameter, S4 and compatible patching/S5 producers.

The old coefficient map need not be onto K; its normalization is expressly required before CRW2. The original point, g=0 Kap, T/TWPl/TWAut/J, both rank-four Links and common threshold remain coupled. Ordinary/control, four Hida endpoints, same-J HasAut and whole Count-II support remain open; RH still needs I/II/V and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH also III.
